title: Level 3 - English as a Second Language for Life Skills

not_verbatim: Demonstrate intermediate-level competence in the language domains of listening, speaking, reading, and writing to navigate everyday, social, and occupational contexts with independence.
Identify main ideas and isolate specific details from authentic listening and reading passages, while using macro-strategies to make predictions and infer the meaning of unfamiliar vocabulary.

Engage in diverse conversational functions—such as persuading, giving clear directions, and expressing professional courtesy—utilizing appropriate formality, stress, and intonation patterns to maintain effective workplace and community relationships.
